mapper.select: INSERT INTO transaction_lock (original_reference, locked_ts, lease_until_ts) VALUES (#{originalReference}, now(), now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds})) ON CONFLICT (original_reference) DO UPDATE SET locked_ts = EXCLUDED.locked_ts, lease_until_ts = EXCLUDED.lease_until_ts WHERE transaction_lock.lease_until_ts <= now() RETURNING original_reference, locked_ts, lease_until_ts
